bug_semantics: Composer loaded configured GitHub OAuth tokens through BaseIO::loadConfiguration(), rejected tokens containing characters outside its allowlist, and embedded the complete rejected token in an UnexpectedValueException. Modern GitHub Actions and GitHub App installation tokens can contain '-' as a base64url character, so the allowlist rejected valid secrets and Symfony Console rendered the exception to stderr, exposing the token in CI logs.
flaw_origin: Commit 0b94fd209aeef3549984f7675e06472177b1ddee first added both the restrictive GitHub token validation and the exception that interpolated the raw token in src/Composer/Factory.php. Commit 14fcff8aa8296d94affd4df37f8b57e3760fbb50 later moved the already-vulnerable logic into src/Composer/IO/BaseIO.php, and commit dc83ba93f3d8a35629f9a387632e8cd373a144d0 later broadened the allowlist to ^[.A-Za-z0-9_]+$ while retaining both the missing '-' and raw-token disclosure; neither later commit is the BIC.
ai_marker: absent: commit object 0b94fd209aeef3549984f7675e06472177b1ddee names Jordi Boggiano <j.boggiano@seld.be> as both author and committer and contains only the subject 'Warn users if github tokens contain invalid chars', with no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, bot identity, or other AI trailer.
evidence: Current first-party records agree the issue is real: GitHub advisory GHSA-f9f8-rm49-7jv2 has withdrawn_at=null and identifies patched versions 1.10.28, 2.2.28, and 2.9.8; the CVE.org API reports CVE-2026-45793 state=PUBLISHED and the same affected ranges and disclosure mechanism.

git blame -L 208,220 472037fb903b3ef27e3107ae210245b2e6cf46cb -- src/Composer/Factory.php attributes the validation and token-bearing exception to 0b94fd209a; git show 0b94fd209aeef3549984f7675e06472177b1ddee shows that this one-parent commit added both lines atomically.

Direct parent-tree verification: git show 23d45f67c1206734fdd91801b07d637f1b2cfd73:src/Composer/Factory.php contains the GitHub OAuth loading loop but no invalid-character regex or token-bearing UnexpectedValueException, while the BIC tree contains both at src/Composer/Factory.php:202-203.

Move exclusion: git show 14fcff8aa8296d94affd4df37f8b57e3760fbb50 deletes the already-vulnerable lines from src/Composer/Factory.php and adds the same lines to the new src/Composer/IO/BaseIO.php, so that refactor is not the first write.

Later-regex exclusion: git show dc83ba93f3d8a35629f9a387632e8cd373a144d0 changes the existing allowlist from ^[.a-z0-9]+$ to ^[.A-Za-z0-9_]+$ but leaves the raw-token exception intact; it does not introduce the disclosure primitive.

BIC-only attribution: git cat-file commit 0b94fd209aeef3549984f7675e06472177b1ddee shows author and committer Jordi Boggiano <j.boggiano@seld.be>, one parent 23d45f67c1206734fdd91801b07d637f1b2cfd73, and no AI/co-author/generated trailer.

Direct mainline fix: git show 3f5e7f9fbfa541137d6d1d5643ec3b718e9d5039 changes BaseIO.php to accept '-' and removes the token value from the exception; its direct parent 4bdb77926affdcad0c3c1bac59e99aadfaf91f82 still has ^[.A-Za-z0-9_]+$ and interpolates the rejected token.

Branch fixes and release topology: 65e6390c49f1a11cd8b660d81822086db51fe2d1 fixes the 2.2 branch and is an ancestor of tag 2.2.28 but not 2.2.27; e66c8fdb7ff5409bd2f358c5f194038e49e93714 fixes the 1.10 branch and is an ancestor of tag 1.10.28 but not 1.10.27; 3f5e7f9fbfa541137d6d1d5643ec3b718e9d5039 is an ancestor of tag 2.9.8 but not 2.9.7.

Affected-boundary topology: git merge-base --is-ancestor confirms BIC 0b94fd209aeef3549984f7675e06472177b1ddee is an ancestor of tags 1.0.0, 2.0.0, and 2.3.0 and remains present in the last vulnerable tags 1.10.27, 2.2.27, and 2.9.7.
reasoning: The security failure is the combination introduced by 0b94fd209aeef3549984f7675e06472177b1ddee: an allowlist rejects some GitHub credentials and the resulting exception discloses the entire rejected secret. The modern hyphenated token format made this old disclosure path commonly reachable, but later allowlist updates and the 2013 BaseIO move did not first create it. The immediate parent directly lacks both vulnerable lines, the BIC is atomic and has one parent, and release ancestry places it before every affected range. The mainline and both maintained-branch fixes remove the disclosure at the documented patched boundaries. Because the BIC commit object is authored and committed by a human and has no AI marker, this real vulnerability is NOT_AI.
